317:t_1:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「...A briefing under the night sky reminds me of $$ヘルマジスタン$$.」

317:t_1:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Things were bad then, too, but a lot better than they are now.」

317:t_1:5.en:
$$ノーマン$$
「I'm sorry dinner couldn't meet your wishes, either.」

317:t_1:6.en:
$n
「That's not true, $$ノーマン$$. It was delicious.」

317:t_1:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He's right. Even without the same ingredients, it's worlds better than $n's survival cooking.」

317:t_1:8.en:
$n
「That's cruel, Miss $$スズネ$$... I did my best without any seasonings or anything...」

317:t_1:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I-I'm sorry...! That just slipped out...」

317:t_1:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$... For that week alone together... did you eat $n's cooking the whole time?」

317:t_1:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Y-yes... We decided to save $$ジェニオン$$'s survival kit in case of an emergency...」

317:t_1:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I imagined a sweet romance with an older woman on an isolated island... but life rarely goes so smoothly.」

317:t_1:13.en:
$$スザク$$
「You had to cook as well as repair $$ジェニオン$$. It must have been hard, $n.」

317:t_1:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-wait a minute! You're making it sound like I didn't do anything!」

317:t_1:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Well... I didn't know wild plants like $n does, and I couldn't catch birds or fish, but...」

317:t_1:18.en:
$$ノーマン$$
「It's all right, $n. Whatever the taste, your sincerity reached Miss $$スズネ$$.」

317:t_1:20.en:
$$ノーマン$$
「As a butler, I make it my principle never to lie.」

317:t_1:21.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The sheep was a liar, though.」

317:t_1:25.en:
$n
「Thank you, $$ノーマン$$. I'll... improve my cooking skills.」

317:t_1:27.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm truly sorry, $n. I... really wasn't any help at all.」

317:t_1:28.en:
$n
「It's all right, Miss $$スズネ$$. Just having you there helped me.」

317:t_1:32.en:
$$スザク$$
(It almost seems... their guardian relationship has been reversed...)

317:t_1:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We've repaired all our machines with the supplies $$ＡＧ$$ procured, but we can't stay like this forever.」

317:t_1:35.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What we can do here is only emergency treatment. We need maintenance by proper mechanics, too.」

317:t_1:36.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Do you have somewhere in mind?」

317:t_1:37.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...As I already told you, $$ミスリル$$'s facilities, including $$メリダ島$$, were destroyed in $$アマルガム$$ attacks.」

317:t_1:38.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Unfortunately, there are no facilities or organizations nearby that can take us in.」

317:t_1:39.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even so, we can't depend on $$ＥＸ－１０$$'s help forever.」

317:t_1:40.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$カン・ユー$$ knows where we are, too.」

317:t_1:41.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「With $c scattered, $$ミスリル$$'s destruction is a major blow.」

317:t_1:42.en:
$$カレン$$
「After $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$, now even $$テッサ$$...」

317:t_1:43.en:
$$クルツ$$
「It'll be all right, $$カレン$$.」

317:t_1:45.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$宗介$$ and $$テッサ$$ are tough as nails. They won't die that easily.」

317:t_1:46.en:
$$マオ$$
「She has the $$デ・ダナン$$. I'm sure she's escaped from $$メリダ島$$.」

317:t_1:48.en:
$$マオ$$
「Of course. She's our superior, our goddess, and our queen.」

317:t_1:49.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Unfortunately, we can't afford to worry about others. First, let's think about our own survival.」

317:t_1:50.en:
$$スズネ$$
「How about joining up with the $$連邦軍$$?」

317:t_1:51.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We don't know how deeply $$クロノ$$ has infiltrated the $$連邦軍$$. That would be dangerous.」

317:t_1:52.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Yes... We could end up walking defenseless into an enemy trap.」

317:t_1:53.en:
$n
「So to get to the $$極東支部$$, where we know we'll be safe, we'd have to cross $$サイデリアル$$'s territory...」

317:t_1:54.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And another major problem is that our operating funds are nearly exhausted.」

317:t_1:56.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$c had sponsors and supporters, including the $$連邦軍$$, but we can't contact them in this situation.」

317:t_1:57.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Until we get through this crisis, we must find our own source of funding.」

317:t_1:58.en:
$$スザク$$
「I never thought we'd have this problem now...」

317:t_1:61.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$クロウ・ブルースト$$... He was in $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, and always moaning about paying off his debts.」

317:t_1:62.en:
$n
「He's the $$リアクター$$ of the $$揺れる天秤$$... I'd heard about him, but he has a lot to deal with...」

317:t_1:63.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I hear there's an arena in $$ナムサク$$, a town a few dozen kilometers from here.」

317:t_1:64.en:
$$カレン$$
「An arena...? Is it something like $$バトリング$$?」

317:t_1:65.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「That's right. Fights between small machines like ASs and ATs are spectacles, and the spectators bet on them.」

317:t_1:68.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ナムサク$$'s arena was one of the places we'd long marked as serving a major organization's private purposes.」

317:t_1:70.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We can't go barging into a place like that in our current state.」

317:t_1:71.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And $$バトリング$$ prize money wouldn't be enough to fund us.」

317:t_1:72.en:
$$マオ$$
「If we could at least join up with $$ヒイロ$$ and the others, we might be able to force our way through, but...」

317:t_1:73.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...In that case, I have the perfect money-making opportunity.」

317:t_1:76.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's a town called $$グルフェー$$ not far from here, and $$ゴウト$$ and the others are there.」

317:t_1:78.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. They seem to be in trouble. I think helping them will solve our problem.」

317:t_1:82.en: ～$$グルフェー$$ Chamber of Commerce　Office～

317:t_1:83.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「...You've saved us, $$ゼロ$$. I never thought you'd agree to wipe out those bandits.」

317:t_1:84.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We have pressing circumstances of our own.」

317:t_1:85.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「To think $c got scattered... A $$時空震動$$ is a terrifying thing.」
